_note: Hand-maintained log of meaningful shipped changes. Newest first.
_versioning: Major bumps for big features / data-model changes. Minor bumps for tweaks, fixes, polish.

entries.title: My Family parents fix, Dashboard filters and totals, Members rename, History page
changes: My Family: parents row now uses union-from-both-directions and pulls in each parent's spouse, so missing co-parents (like Doan's mother) show up automatically
My Family: children row now includes each child's spouse (in-laws); grandchildren also include kids of the in-law
Family Tree: emoji slot in the toolbar is no longer hidden by the global data-admin-only rule
Dashboard: Birthdays / Anniversaries / Events / Holidays / Reminders are now clickable filter chips above the upcoming list
Dashboard: new 'This month's gifts' panel — received, given, and net for the current calendar month
Dashboard: each event row in Upcoming now shows its rolling gift totals (in / out / net)
Dashboard: gift tracker now only shows 'given' gifts that aren't yet fully purchased + sent — received gifts no longer clutter the tracker
Admin nav tab and page title renamed to 'Members'
New History page (admin only) — this changelog

entries.title: Family Tree card overflow, group filter ancestors, My Family per-child routing
changes: Family Tree: .node overflows visible so the 'In loving memory' badge and the '+' button aren't clipped; the photo handles its own corner-rounding
Family Tree: removed the desaturate-on-death photo filter
Family Tree: Group filter keep-set now walks every ancestor (and ancestor spouses) so the tree stays vertical instead of collapsing into a horizontal row
Family Tree: emoji slot moved out of a hidden floating position into the toolbar
My Family: per-child routing — each child's trunk drops from their actual visible bio parent(s), so step-parents no longer get a line down to non-bio children
My Family: focus row now [current spouse, focus, ex1, ex2, ...] — current to one side, exes to the other
My Family: added a 4th row for grandchildren

entries.title: Family Tree polish, My Family ex-spouses, Dashboard tweaks, Admin sort and login column, page emojis
changes: Family Tree: 'In loving memory' badge on the profile card when a date of death is set; age caps at date of death
Family Tree: Tree.relations does union-from-both-directions and healMissingKeys heals asymmetric parent/child/ex-spouse links every load
My Family: renders current spouse + every ex on the focus row with broken-heart lines; children from any marriage hang from the correct couple
Dashboard: Upcoming horizon extended to 60 days; US holidays merged in
Dashboard: gift tracker hides rows where both purchased AND sent are checked
Admin: Name column header is clickable, toggles between by-last and by-first sort
Admin: new 'Login' column showing whether the member has a Supabase auth row
Page emojis: admins can set an emoji per page; updates both the H2 and the nav tab

entries.title: Dashboard, profile additions, calendar reminders, travel trips
changes: Profile drawer: date of death, 529 plan URL, notes, in-drawer gifts section (received / given with totals and event links)
Admin members table: inline copy-email button per row
Calendar: birthday chip recolored green to distinguish from US holiday red; legend updated
Calendar: new 'Calendar reminder' type — recurring (daily / weekly / monthly / yearly), Calendar-only (no Events page entry)
Events: 'This is a travel trip' toggle adds destination, end date, four budget categories, and a daily itinerary editor; event detail shows budget table and itinerary
Dashboard (new, admin-only): Las Vegas clock + weather (Open-Meteo), next-30-day upcoming list, quick gift tracker with purchased/sent checkboxes, shared family grocery list
Routing: admins land on Dashboard after sign-in

entries.title: Multiple ex-spouses, photo recrop, Group + My Family tree filters
changes: Multi-spouse data model: exSpouseIds[] on every member; the Mark-as-divorced flow moves the current spouse into the ex array (one-way) and the canvas draws each ex with a long-dashed broken heart
healMissingKeys migrates legacy 'divorced flag on current spouse' pairs into the new model
Profile edit drawer: 'Crop photo' button re-runs the cropper on an existing photo
Family Tree toolbar: Group dropdown and My Family toggle as mutually-exclusive view filters

entries.title: Edge Function for admin password reset
changes: New Supabase Edge Function admin-reset-password (service_role server-side) so admins can set a member's password directly from the website without an email round-trip
Client toast surfaces a 'deploy the Edge Function first' hint when the function call fails

entries.title: Smart Reset PW handles missing logins; recovery modal fixes
changes: Admin Reset PW probes member_accounts first; if no login exists, it offers to create one on the spot
Open recovery modal directly when the URL has a recovery hash (fixes a race where the listener fired before the callback was wired)

entries.title: Mirror members into Supabase Auth on create
changes: Member create form gains an Email field; saving creates a Supabase Auth user via a session-less throwaway client (admin stays logged in)
member_accounts row inserted linking auth user to member; credentials modal shows email + generated password once

entries.title: RLS policy fixes; admin password reset via email
changes: Split member_accounts policies per operation to break the 'infinite recursion in policy' error
Add explicit INSERT policy on archive so PostgREST .upsert() works
Admin Reset PW uses resetPasswordForEmail and a recovery-mode change-password modal on the receiving end

entries.title: Supabase backend wire-up + auth
changes: Replaced localStorage-only storage with Supabase: JSONB-blob single-row archive + member_accounts mapping + RLS
Auth flow switched from local username/passwordHash to Supabase email/password with realtime sync

entries.title: Calendar, expenses, anniversaries, photo crop, profile fields
changes: Calendar page with events, birthdays, US holidays; Google Calendar sync; recurring per-attendee expenses; anniversary tracking; photo crop modal; long batch of profile improvements

entries.title: Initial commit
changes: Family Archive web app — vanilla JS, single-file index.html + app.js + styles.css
